title: Picard affine structure projective representation
statement: Let f:X→S be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation; let M be an X-module, k:W→S, and U an affine open of W such that the tensor pullback of M to X×S U is isomorphic to its structure sheaf. With R=Gamma(W,U), the restriction to the localized U-site of R(pullback.snd f k)_*((pullback.fst f k)^*M[0]) is isomorphic to Q of the termwise affinePerfectSheafification W U hU of some bounded complex P of finite projective R-modules. Use the supplied derived categories on all schemes and localized open sites. No universal structure-unit or homology hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Exact restriction and open base change identify the specified restricted image with R(f_U)_* of the coefficient on X×S U. Use the given trivialization to identify the coefficient with O. The base-changed f is flat, proper and of finite presentation; O is finitely presented and relatively flat. Tag 0B91(2) makes its direct image perfect.

Transport the perfect image to Spec Gamma(W,U) through isoSpec and the equivalence of localized-site modules with modules on U. Use the affine derived quasi-coherent dictionary and the affine bounded-projective characterization to get a bounded finite-projective module complex. Transport the representing isomorphism back; termwise transport is the stated affinePerfectSheafification functor. The empty affine and zero ring give the zero complex.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_affine_structure_projective_representation
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (M : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (htrivial : Nonempty
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ k))).obj M ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf)) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} (W.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (W.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (P.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective (W.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (P.X n)) ∧
      Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
        (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj M))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((affinePerfectSheafification W U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
